subject: economics
title: Taxes and Subsidies
welcome_lead: Use prices to push the market toward the social optimum.
meta_desc: A-Level Government Intervention: taxes and subsidies.
final_note: Taxes and subsidies move market price toward social cost or benefit.

concepts.def: Tax on spending - like VAT or excise.
Government payment to producers or consumers.
Who really bears the tax - depends on elasticity.
Tax equal to marginal external cost.

walkthroughs.body_html: An indirect tax shifts the supply curve up by the tax amount. Price rises, quantity falls, government earns revenue. Used for negative externalities (cigarettes, alcohol).
A subsidy shifts supply down by the subsidy amount. Price falls, quantity rises, government spends. Used for positive externalities (education, renewable energy).
If demand is inelastic, consumers pay most of the tax (cigarettes). If demand is elastic, producers bear most. Tax incidence rarely matches the legal liability.
